# Set up: Process framework template

Tested on PAD 2.73.155 · v1.0.2

*For e-learning purposes only: try it in a test environment with the sample data, and review it before any real use. [Disclaimer](../../START-HERE.md#disclaimer)*

From the path that asks the least to the one that asks the most. Stop at the one you need.

| Path | You create | Needs | Time |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[1. Rebuild the template](#1-rebuild-the-template)**<br>Every subflow and variable in place, saved as a template of your environment. | 10 local subflows, 35 inputs, 35 outputs | PAD only | 90 min |
| **[2. A process from the template](#2-a-process-from-the-template)**<br>**New › Flow from template**, then the regions the code marks `TEMPLATE`. | The regions marked TEMPLATE in 4 subflows | The template | Depends on your flow |

## 1. Rebuild the template

### 1.1 Create the template and its subflows

**+ New flow**, name `PAD_REF`, **Create**. In the designer, **File › Save as**: the same name, **Type: Template**, **Save**. The designer now shows the badge *Template* next to the name.
 Then for each subflow: **Subflows** above the canvas › **New**, name, scope, **Save**.

| Subflow name | Scope | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `Tests` | Global | 24 cases: each function and each recovery path called with fixed inputs, one PASS or FAIL line per case in a report. Run it with Run from here on its first action. *(optional)* |
| `Verify` | Local | Writes one PASS or FAIL line of Tests to the report. *(optional)* |
| `Init_Run` | Local | Creates the project folders (missing parents included) and builds the run id and the name of the daily log file. |
| `Write_Log` | Local | One line per event, filtered by level; WARN and above also go to the run log of Power Automate. |
| `Load_Config` | Local | Defaults, then the rows of Config.csv for every environment, then the rows of the current environment; numbers checked; returned as JSON. |
| `Get_Work_Items` | Local | Reads every work item once, as a table (one row = one transaction); writes the demo file when asked. |
| `Process_Item` | Local | One transaction: the business rules, the application steps and the outcome of the item. |
| `Take_Evidence` | Local | A screenshot named after the run, the item and the attempt. |
| `Close_Applications` | Local | Closes the running processes of a list: at start, before a retry and at the end. |
| `Write_Run_Report` | Local | The result of every item as a CSV file and as an HTML page. |
| `Send_Notification` | Local | The HTML report by Outlook, as a draft or sent; NONE turns it off. |
| `To_Json_Text` | Local | Escapes a text for a JSON value. |

> [!WARNING]
> The scope **Local** is easily lost while you type the name. Check it just before **Save**.

Pictures: [Create a subflow](../../docs/create-a-subflow.md).

### 1.3 Paste the code

Open the tab of the subflow, click its empty canvas, **Ctrl+V**.

**`Main`** ← [`flow/1-Main.txt`](flow/1-Main.txt). Check: 193 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (193 lines)</summary>

```text
# ===== Main (global): PAD_REF - transaction framework : Init > Get work items > Process each item (retry, business / system exceptions) > End =====
# Main never stops on an unexpected error : the run is marked FATAL, the report and the outputs are still written.
# TEMPLATE: keep Main as it is ; adapt Process_Item (business steps), Get_Work_Items (source) and the defaults of Load_Config (settings). A new input of Process_Item is also given by its CALL, in region 2.3.1.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Everything the end of Main reads is defined here first : even a run that crashes in the first second can still write its report and outputs.'
**REGION 1. Minimal state : outputs, counters and safe defaults the end of the run must find defined
@@CustomNote: 'Pessimistic by default : Success becomes True only in region 5, when the run really reached COMPLETED.'
SET out_glob_bool_Success TO False
@@CustomNote: 'Empty until a FATAL or ABORTED run : the cloud flow shows this text to explain why the run stopped.'
SET out_glob_txt_ErrorMessage TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Filled in region 4 with the JSON summary ; empty here so a crash before that point returns an empty, not a stale, summary.'
SET out_glob_txt_RunSummary TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'State machine of the run : RUNNING, then COMPLETED, ABORTED (circuit breaker) or FATAL (unexpected error).'
SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''RUNNING'''
@@CustomNote: 'Reason of a stop, in plain words ; it ends up in ErrorMessage and in the FATAL log line.'
SET txt_FatalReason TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Set by Init_Run ; every log line, report and screenshot carries it so one run can be traced end to end.'
SET txt_RunId TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Empty until Init_Run builds the path : Write_Log then simply reports FAILED instead of crashing.'
SET txt_LogFile TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Empty until Init_Run : Write_Run_Report refuses an empty folder instead of writing to the root of the disk.'
SET txt_ReportsFolder TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Path of the CSV report, quoted in the summary JSON and in the last log line.'
SET txt_ReportCsv TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'HTML body of the report, reused as the body of the notification e-mail.'
SET txt_ReportHtmlBody TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Duration of the run in seconds, as text without decimals so the JSON summary stays valid in every Windows locale.'
SET txt_RunSeconds TO $'''0'''
@@CustomNote: 'Reserved for an error inside the end of the run itself (region 4) ; it never stops the clean-up.'
SET txt_FinishError TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'No application is closed until Config.csv says which ones : a safe default for the first seconds of the run.'
SET txt_ProcessesToClose TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'NONE until the configuration is read : no e-mail can leave by accident before the settings are known.'
SET txt_NotifyChannel TO $'''NONE'''
@@CustomNote: 'Recipients of the run report, read from Config.csv (NotifyTo).'
SET txt_NotifyTo TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Outlook account that sends the report, read from Config.csv (NotifyAccount).'
SET txt_NotifyAccount TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'By default only runs that need attention are notified ; a quiet inbox makes real alerts visible.'
SET bool_NotifyOnSuccess TO False
@@CustomNote: 'Number of items returned by Get_Work_Items : the denominator of every count in the report.'
SET num_ItemsRead TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Items actually processed : lower than ItemsRead when MaxItems or the circuit breaker stopped the loop.'
SET num_ItemsHandled TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Business view : transactions done.'
SET num_Success TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Business view : items rejected because of their data ; the business team corrects them.'
SET num_BusinessExceptions TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Support view : items that failed for a technical reason even after the retries.'
SET num_SystemExceptions TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Retries after a system exception : a high number reveals an unstable application before it becomes an incident.'
SET num_Retries TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Circuit breaker counter : reset by every SUCCESS or BUSINESS_EXCEPTION, compared to MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions.'
SET num_ConsecutiveSystemExceptions TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Upper case so dev, Dev and DEV select the same rows of Config.csv.'
Text.ChangeCase Text: in_glob_txt_Environment NewCase: Text.CaseOption.UpperCase Result=> txt_Environment
@@CustomNote: 'Start time of the run, used for the duration in the summary and in the last log line.'
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_RunStart
@@CustomNote: 'One row per item, filled by region 2.3.2 : this table becomes the CSV and HTML report of the run.'
Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { ^['RunId', 'ItemKey', 'Outcome', 'Attempts', 'Reason', 'Result', 'StartedAt', 'DurationMs'] } DataTable=> tbl_Results
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Everything that can fail sits inside BLOCK Run : an unexpected error jumps to region 3 instead of stopping the robot.'
**REGION 2. Guarded run : an unexpected error marks the run FATAL and goes on to the end of Main
@@CustomNote: 'Guarded zone : its handler only sets the status to FATAL, so the end of Main (report, outputs, clean-up) always runs.'
BLOCK Run
ON BLOCK ERROR
    SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''FATAL'''
END
    @@regionColor: '#C6E0B4'
    @@CustomNote: 'Init : prepare the ground before touching any work item.'
    **REGION 2.1 Init : folders, run id, log file, configuration, applications closed
    @@CustomNote: 'Creates the project folders when missing and gives the run its id and its daily log file.'
    CALL Init_Run in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder: in_glob_txt_ProjectFolder in_loc_txt_ProcessName: in_glob_txt_ProcessName out_loc_txt_RunId=> txt_RunId out_loc_txt_LogFile=> txt_LogFile out_loc_txt_ConfigFile=> txt_ConfigFile out_loc_txt_InputFolder=> txt_InputFolder out_loc_txt_OutputFolder=> txt_OutputFolder out_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder=> txt_EvidenceFolder out_loc_txt_ReportsFolder=> txt_ReportsFolder out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_InitOk
    @@CustomNote: 'Without its folders the robot cannot log or report : the run stops here, cleanly.'
    IF bool_InitOk = False THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'FATAL : the steps below are skipped, the end of Main still writes what it can.'
        SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''FATAL'''
        @@CustomNote: 'The message tells the support team exactly which folder could not be created.'
        SET txt_FatalReason TO $'''Init_Run failed: the project folders could not be created under %in_glob_txt_ProjectFolder%'''
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'Each stage runs only while the run is still RUNNING : a simple pattern instead of GOTO jumps.'
    IF txt_RunStatus = $'''RUNNING''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'First log line of the run : the inputs it received, so a run can be replayed with the same values.'
        CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''INFO''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Init''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Run started : process %in_glob_txt_ProcessName%, environment %txt_Environment%, project folder %in_glob_txt_ProjectFolder%, max items %in_glob_num_MaxItems%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
        @@CustomNote: 'Reads Config.csv (created with defaults when missing), applies the rows of the current environment and checks the numbers.'
        CALL Load_Config in_loc_txt_ConfigFile: txt_ConfigFile in_loc_txt_Environment: txt_Environment out_loc_txt_ConfigJson=> txt_ConfigJson out_loc_num_SettingsRead=> num_SettingsRead out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_ConfigOk out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_ConfigDetail
        @@CustomNote: 'A wrong configuration stops the run before any item is touched : better no run than a half wrong one.'
        IF bool_ConfigOk = False THEN
            @@CustomNote: 'FATAL : the robot does not guess a missing or wrong setting.'
            SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''FATAL'''
            @@CustomNote: 'The detail names the faulty setting, so the fix is a one line change in Config.csv.'
            SET txt_FatalReason TO $'''Load_Config failed: %txt_ConfigDetail%'''
        END
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'The settings are read once, here, into typed variables : the rest of Main never reads the JSON again.'
    IF txt_RunStatus = $'''RUNNING''' THEN
        # Settings are read once into typed variables : every key exists (defaults of Load_Config) and the numbers were checked there
        @@CustomNote: 'Load_Config returns text (a text crosses the boundary of a local subflow) ; it becomes an object here.'
        Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: txt_ConfigJson CustomObject=> obj_Config
        @@CustomNote: 'Every key exists (defaults of Load_Config) and was checked as a number there : this conversion cannot fail.'
        Text.ToNumber Text: obj_Config['MaxRetryNumber'] Number=> num_MaxRetryNumber
        @@CustomNote: 'Circuit breaker threshold : how many system exceptions in a row stop the run.'
        Text.ToNumber Text: obj_Config['MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions'] Number=> num_MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions
        @@CustomNote: 'Pause before a retry : gives a slow application time to come back.'
        Text.ToNumber Text: obj_Config['RetryDelaySeconds'] Number=> num_RetryDelaySeconds
        @@CustomNote: 'Screenshots cost disk space and may show data : they can be switched off per environment.'
        SET bool_ScreenshotOnError TO obj_Config['ScreenshotOnSystemException'] = $'''True'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Demo mode : True in the template so it runs out of the box, False in a real process.'
        SET bool_CreateDemoInput TO obj_Config['CreateDemoInput'] = $'''True'''
        @@CustomNote: 'The input file name comes from Config.csv, its folder from the project layout.'
        SET txt_InputFile TO $'''%txt_InputFolder%\\%obj_Config['InputFile']%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Comma separated process names (EXCEL,msedge) closed at start, before each retry and at the end.'
        SET txt_ProcessesToClose TO obj_Config['ProcessesToClose']
        @@CustomNote: 'NONE, OUTLOOK_DRAFT or OUTLOOK_SEND : DEV usually drafts, PROD sends.'
        SET txt_NotifyChannel TO obj_Config['NotifyChannel']
        @@CustomNote: 'Recipients of the run report.'
        SET txt_NotifyTo TO obj_Config['NotifyTo']
        @@CustomNote: 'Outlook account used to send the report (and passed to Process_Item when the business steps need it).'
        SET txt_NotifyAccount TO obj_Config['NotifyAccount']
        @@CustomNote: 'Also notify fully successful runs : useful at go live, noisy afterwards.'
        SET bool_NotifyOnSuccess TO obj_Config['NotifyOnSuccess'] = $'''True'''
        @@CustomNote: 'DEBUG line : the effective settings, visible only when the log level is DEBUG.'
        CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''DEBUG''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Init''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Configuration : %num_SettingsRead% row(s) applied from %txt_ConfigFile% ; retries %num_MaxRetryNumber%, consecutive system exceptions limit %num_MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions%, notification %txt_NotifyChannel%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
        # A known state before the first item : the applications left open by a previous run are closed
        @@CustomNote: 'Known state before the first item : applications left open by a previous run are closed.'
        CALL Close_Applications in_loc_txt_ProcessNames: txt_ProcessesToClose out_loc_num_Closed=> num_Closed out_loc_bool_Ok=> _bool_CloseOk
    END
    **ENDREGION
    @@regionColor: '#C6E0B4'
    @@CustomNote: 'Get work items : the work list is read once, before any processing.'
    **REGION 2.2 Get work items : the whole list, read once
    @@CustomNote: 'Skipped when Init already failed.'
    IF txt_RunStatus = $'''RUNNING''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'One row = one transaction ; replace Get_Work_Items to plug another source (Excel, SQL, API).'
        CALL Get_Work_Items in_loc_txt_InputFile: txt_InputFile in_loc_bool_CreateDemo: bool_CreateDemoInput out_loc_tbl_Items=> tbl_Items out_loc_num_Count=> num_ItemsRead out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_ItemsOk out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_ItemsDetail
        @@CustomNote: 'No work list, no run : a missing source is FATAL, not an empty run.'
        IF bool_ItemsOk = False THEN
            @@CustomNote: 'FATAL : nothing was processed, the report says so.'
            SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''FATAL'''
            @@CustomNote: 'The detail says whether the file was missing or unreadable.'
            SET txt_FatalReason TO $'''Get_Work_Items failed: %txt_ItemsDetail%'''
        ELSE
            @@CustomNote: 'INFO line with the number of items : the first figure the business team checks in the log.'
            CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''INFO''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Get_Work_Items''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''%num_ItemsRead% work item(s) read from %txt_InputFile%. %txt_ItemsDetail%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
        END
    END
    **ENDREGION
    @@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
    @@CustomNote: 'Process : the heart of the framework, one transaction per row with retries and a circuit breaker.'
    **REGION 2.3 Process : one transaction per item, a system exception is retried after a recovery
    @@CustomNote: 'Skipped when Init or Get work items failed.'
    IF txt_RunStatus = $'''RUNNING''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'One pass per work item ; the row travels to Process_Item as a DataRow.'
        LOOP FOREACH row_Item IN tbl_Items
            @@CustomNote: 'MaxItems bounds a smoke run (1 item in production for a first test) ; 0 means no limit.'
            IF in_glob_num_MaxItems > 0 AND num_ItemsHandled >= in_glob_num_MaxItems THEN
                @@CustomNote: 'The log says why the run stopped early : the remaining items are not lost, they wait for the next run.'
                CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''INFO''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Process''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''MaxItems reached (%in_glob_num_MaxItems%) : the remaining items are left for the next run''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
                @@CustomNote: 'Leaves the item loop ; the end of Main still writes the report of what was done.'
                EXIT LOOP
            END
            @@regionColor: '#BDD7EE'
            @@CustomNote: 'Attempts : an item gets up to 1 + MaxRetryNumber attempts, only when the failure is technical.'
            **REGION 2.3.1 Attempts : SUCCESS and BUSINESS_EXCEPTION are final, SYSTEM_EXCEPTION is retried up to MaxRetryNumber times
            @@CustomNote: 'Counts the item as handled before its first attempt, whatever its outcome.'
            SET num_ItemsHandled TO num_ItemsHandled + 1
            @@CustomNote: 'Attempt counter of this item, shown in the report and in the screenshot names.'
            SET num_Attempt TO 0
            @@CustomNote: 'PENDING keeps the attempt loop going ; only a final outcome leaves it.'
            SET txt_Outcome TO $'''PENDING'''
            @@CustomNote: 'Reset for each item : the values of the previous item must never leak into this one.'
            SET txt_ItemKey TO $''''''
            @@CustomNote: 'Reset for each item, like the key.'
            SET txt_Reason TO $''''''
            @@CustomNote: 'Reset for each item, like the key.'
            SET txt_Result TO $''''''
            @@CustomNote: 'Start time of the item, for its duration in the report.'
            DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_ItemStart
            @@CustomNote: 'Retry loop : runs again only while the outcome is still PENDING.'
            LOOP WHILE txt_Outcome = $'''PENDING'''
                @@CustomNote: 'One more attempt for this item.'
                SET num_Attempt TO num_Attempt + 1
                @@CustomNote: 'ONE transaction : Process_Item says SUCCESS, BUSINESS_EXCEPTION or SYSTEM_EXCEPTION and never throws.'
                CALL Process_Item in_loc_row_Item: row_Item in_loc_txt_OutputFolder: txt_OutputFolder in_loc_num_Attempt: num_Attempt out_loc_txt_ItemKey=> txt_ItemKey out_loc_txt_Outcome=> txt_AttemptOutcome out_loc_txt_Reason=> txt_Reason out_loc_txt_Result=> txt_Result
                @@CustomNote: 'SUCCESS and BUSINESS_EXCEPTION are final : replaying a wrong data gives the same result.'
                IF txt_AttemptOutcome = $'''SUCCESS''' OR txt_AttemptOutcome = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' THEN
                    @@CustomNote: 'The outcome of this attempt becomes the outcome of the item.'
                    SET txt_Outcome TO txt_AttemptOutcome
                    @@CustomNote: 'A working application resets the circuit breaker.'
                    SET num_ConsecutiveSystemExceptions TO 0
                ELSE
                    @@CustomNote: 'One more system exception in a row : the circuit breaker gets closer.'
                    SET num_ConsecutiveSystemExceptions TO num_ConsecutiveSystemExceptions + 1
                    @@CustomNote: 'WARN line for each failed attempt, with the exact message of the failed action.'
                    CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''WARN''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Process_Item''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''System exception on item %txt_ItemKey%, attempt %num_Attempt% : %txt_Reason%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
                    @@CustomNote: 'The screenshot shows the support team what was on screen at the moment of the failure.'
                    IF bool_ScreenshotOnError = True THEN
                        @@CustomNote: 'PNG named run / item / attempt in the Evidence folder.'
                        CALL Take_Evidence in_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder: txt_EvidenceFolder in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_ItemKey: txt_ItemKey in_loc_num_Attempt: num_Attempt out_loc_txt_File=> txt_EvidenceFile out_loc_bool_Ok=> _bool_EvidenceOk
                    END
                    @@CustomNote: 'Circuit breaker : the same failure on and on means the application is down, not the item.'
                    IF num_ConsecutiveSystemExceptions >= num_MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions THEN
                        @@CustomNote: 'The current item is recorded as a system exception.'
                        SET txt_Outcome TO $'''SYSTEM_EXCEPTION'''
                        @@CustomNote: 'ABORTED stops the item loop ; the end of Main still runs.'
                        SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''ABORTED'''
                        @@CustomNote: 'The reason quotes the last failure : the first clue for the support team.'
                        SET txt_FatalReason TO $'''Run aborted after %num_ConsecutiveSystemExceptions% system exceptions in a row (MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions = %num_MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions%). Last one : %txt_Reason%'''
                    ELSE IF num_Attempt > num_MaxRetryNumber THEN
                        @@CustomNote: 'Retries exhausted : the item is a system exception, the run goes on with the next item.'
                        SET txt_Outcome TO $'''SYSTEM_EXCEPTION'''
                    ELSE
                        # Recovery before the retry : the applications are closed so the next attempt starts from a known state
                        @@CustomNote: 'Counted for the report : retries reveal unstable applications.'
                        SET num_Retries TO num_Retries + 1
                        @@CustomNote: 'Recovery : the applications are closed so the next attempt starts from a known state.'
                        CALL Close_Applications in_loc_txt_ProcessNames: txt_ProcessesToClose out_loc_num_Closed=> num_Closed out_loc_bool_Ok=> _bool_CloseOk
                        @@CustomNote: 'Deliberate pause before the retry (RetryDelaySeconds), not a synchronisation wait.'
                        WAIT num_RetryDelaySeconds
                    END
                END
            END
            **ENDREGION
            @@regionColor: '#BDD7EE'
            @@CustomNote: 'Transaction status : every item leaves the same traces, whatever its outcome.'
            **REGION 2.3.2 Transaction status : counters, one result row and one log line per item
            @@CustomNote: 'End time of the item.'
            DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_ItemEnd
            @@CustomNote: 'Duration of the item, attempts and pauses included.'
            DateTime.Subtract FromDate: date_ItemEnd SubstractDate: date_ItemStart TimeUnit: DateTime.DifferenceTimeUnit.Seconds TimeDifference=> num_ItemSeconds
            @@CustomNote: 'Milliseconds without decimals : the same text in every Windows locale.'
            Text.FromNumber Number: num_ItemSeconds * 1000 DecimalPlaces: 0 UseThousandsSeparator: False FormattedNumber=> txt_ItemMs
            @@CustomNote: 'Start time written as text in a fixed format, for Excel or Power BI.'
            Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: date_ItemStart CustomFormat: $'''yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss''' Result=> txt_ItemStart
            @@CustomNote: 'One row of the report per item : key, outcome, attempts, reason, result, start, duration.'
            Variables.AddRowToDataTable.AppendRowToDataTable DataTable: tbl_Results RowToAdd: [txt_RunId, txt_ItemKey, txt_Outcome, num_Attempt, txt_Reason, txt_Result, txt_ItemStart, txt_ItemMs]
            @@CustomNote: 'One log line per item, its level following the outcome.'
            IF txt_Outcome = $'''SUCCESS''' THEN
                @@CustomNote: 'Business count of transactions done.'
                SET num_Success TO num_Success + 1
                @@CustomNote: 'INFO : the result of the transaction (a file, a draft, an id) is quoted.'
                CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''INFO''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Process''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Item %txt_ItemKey% : SUCCESS in %num_Attempt% attempt(s), %txt_ItemMs% ms ; %txt_Result%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
            ELSE IF txt_Outcome = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' THEN
                @@CustomNote: 'Business count of data errors.'
                SET num_BusinessExceptions TO num_BusinessExceptions + 1
                @@CustomNote: 'WARN : the business team reads the reason and corrects the data.'
                CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''WARN''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Process''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Item %txt_ItemKey% : BUSINESS_EXCEPTION ; %txt_Reason%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
            ELSE
                @@CustomNote: 'Support count of technical failures.'
                SET num_SystemExceptions TO num_SystemExceptions + 1
                @@CustomNote: 'ERROR : the support team reads the reason and the screenshots.'
                CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''ERROR''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Process''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Item %txt_ItemKey% : SYSTEM_EXCEPTION after %num_Attempt% attempt(s) ; %txt_Reason%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
            END
            **ENDREGION
            @@CustomNote: 'A circuit breaker inside the attempts also stops the item loop.'
            IF txt_RunStatus <> $'''RUNNING''' THEN
                @@CustomNote: 'Leaves the item loop after an ABORTED.'
                EXIT LOOP
            END
        END
    END
    **ENDREGION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Run status : decide COMPLETED, ABORTED or FATAL and explain it.'
**REGION 3. Run status : COMPLETED, ABORTED or FATAL with the message of the unexpected error on one line
@@CustomNote: 'FATAL without a reason means an unexpected error caught by BLOCK Run : its message is read here.'
IF txt_RunStatus = $'''FATAL''' AND txt_FatalReason = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Get last error : the message of the action that failed (subflow, action, error, details).'
    ERROR => txt_LastError
    @@CustomNote: 'The message is put on one line : a log line and a JSON value must not break.'
    Text.Replace.ReplaceTextWithRegex Text: txt_LastError TextToFind: $'''\\s*[\\r\\n]+\\s*''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $''' / ''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> txt_FatalReason
END
@@CustomNote: 'Nobody stopped the run : it is COMPLETED, even with items in exception.'
IF txt_RunStatus = $'''RUNNING''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'COMPLETED means the robot did its job ; item exceptions are results, not robot failures.'
    SET txt_RunStatus TO $'''COMPLETED'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'A stopped run leaves one FATAL line in the log.'
IF txt_FatalReason <> $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'FATAL line : status and reason, also sent to the Power Automate run log.'
    CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''FATAL''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Main''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''%txt_RunStatus% : %txt_FatalReason%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'End : report, summary and notification, each one isolated so none can stop the clean-up.'
**REGION 4. End : run report, JSON summary, notification - each step reports its own failure, none stops the end
@@CustomNote: 'Second guarded zone : a failure in the report or the e-mail never prevents the outputs from being set.'
BLOCK Finish
ON BLOCK ERROR
    SET txt_FinishError TO $'''The end of the run failed : see the error list of the run'''
END
    @@CustomNote: 'End time of the run.'
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_RunEnd
    @@CustomNote: 'Duration of the whole run.'
    DateTime.Subtract FromDate: date_RunEnd SubstractDate: date_RunStart TimeUnit: DateTime.DifferenceTimeUnit.Seconds TimeDifference=> num_RunSeconds
    @@CustomNote: 'Seconds without decimals : valid JSON in every Windows locale.'
    Text.FromNumber Number: num_RunSeconds DecimalPlaces: 0 UseThousandsSeparator: False FormattedNumber=> txt_RunSeconds
    @@CustomNote: 'CSV for Excel or Power BI and HTML for people : one row per item.'
    CALL Write_Run_Report in_loc_tbl_Results: tbl_Results in_loc_txt_ReportsFolder: txt_ReportsFolder in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_Title: $'''%in_glob_txt_ProcessName% - %txt_Environment% - %txt_RunStatus%''' out_loc_txt_CsvFile=> txt_ReportCsv out_loc_txt_HtmlFile=> txt_ReportHtml out_loc_txt_Html=> txt_ReportHtmlBody out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_ReportOk
    @@CustomNote: 'A report that could not be written is not quoted in the summary.'
    IF bool_ReportOk = False THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'The summary points to no file rather than to a missing one.'
        SET txt_ReportCsv TO $''''''
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'Paths contain backslashes : escaped so the JSON stays valid.'
    CALL To_Json_Text in_loc_txt_Text: txt_ReportCsv out_loc_txt_Json=> txt_ReportCsvJson
    @@CustomNote: 'The fatal reason may contain quotes or backslashes : escaped too.'
    CALL To_Json_Text in_loc_txt_Text: txt_FatalReason out_loc_txt_Json=> txt_FatalReasonJson
    @@CustomNote: 'The process name is free text typed by a maker : escaped as well.'
    CALL To_Json_Text in_loc_txt_Text: in_glob_txt_ProcessName out_loc_txt_Json=> txt_ProcessNameJson
    @@CustomNote: 'JSON summary of the run : what a cloud flow reads to decide what to do next.'
    SET out_glob_txt_RunSummary TO $'''{\"runId\": \"%txt_RunId%\", \"process\": \"%txt_ProcessNameJson%\", \"environment\": \"%txt_Environment%\", \"status\": \"%txt_RunStatus%\", \"itemsRead\": %num_ItemsRead%, \"itemsHandled\": %num_ItemsHandled%, \"success\": %num_Success%, \"businessExceptions\": %num_BusinessExceptions%, \"systemExceptions\": %num_SystemExceptions%, \"retries\": %num_Retries%, \"durationSeconds\": %txt_RunSeconds%, \"report\": \"%txt_ReportCsvJson%\", \"error\": \"%txt_FatalReasonJson%\"}'''
    # Self-check : the summary is read back as JSON, the way a cloud flow will parse it
    @@CustomNote: 'The summary is checked before it leaves the robot.'
    SET bool_SummaryOk TO True
    @@CustomNote: 'Self check : the summary is parsed back as JSON, the way the cloud flow will parse it.'
    Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: out_glob_txt_RunSummary CustomObject=> _obj_SummaryCheck
    ON ERROR
        SET bool_SummaryOk TO False
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'An invalid summary is logged rather than hidden.'
    IF bool_SummaryOk = False THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'WARN line with the faulty summary, to fix the template.'
        CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''WARN''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''End''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''The run summary is not valid JSON : %out_glob_txt_RunSummary%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'Notify only when someone has something to do, unless NotifyOnSuccess asks for every run.'
    SET bool_Notify TO bool_NotifyOnSuccess = True OR txt_RunStatus <> $'''COMPLETED''' OR num_BusinessExceptions > 0 OR num_SystemExceptions > 0
    @@CustomNote: 'No notification for a quiet, fully successful run.'
    IF bool_Notify = True THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Outlook draft or e-mail with the HTML report ; NONE in the demo.'
        CALL Send_Notification in_loc_txt_Channel: txt_NotifyChannel in_loc_txt_To: txt_NotifyTo in_loc_txt_Account: txt_NotifyAccount in_loc_txt_Subject: $'''[%txt_RunStatus%] %in_glob_txt_ProcessName% %txt_Environment% : %num_Success% success, %num_BusinessExceptions% business, %num_SystemExceptions% system''' in_loc_txt_HtmlBody: txt_ReportHtmlBody out_loc_bool_Sent=> bool_NotificationSent out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_NotificationDetail
        @@CustomNote: 'DEBUG line : whether the notification left and why.'
        CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: $'''DEBUG''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''End''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Notification sent %bool_NotificationSent% : %txt_NotificationDetail%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
    END
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Clean-up and outputs : always run, after a success as after a crash.'
**REGION 5. Clean-up and outputs : applications closed, flow outputs set, one summary line in the log
@@CustomNote: 'Applications are closed so the next run starts clean.'
CALL Close_Applications in_loc_txt_ProcessNames: txt_ProcessesToClose out_loc_num_Closed=> num_Closed out_loc_bool_Ok=> _bool_CloseOk
@@CustomNote: 'Success is True only for COMPLETED ; the cloud flow branches on it.'
SET out_glob_bool_Success TO txt_RunStatus = $'''COMPLETED'''
@@CustomNote: 'Empty for a COMPLETED run, the reason otherwise.'
SET out_glob_txt_ErrorMessage TO txt_FatalReason
@@CustomNote: 'Level of the last log line, INFO for a successful run.'
SET txt_EndLevel TO $'''INFO'''
@@CustomNote: 'A run that did not complete ends with an ERROR line, easy to filter.'
IF out_glob_bool_Success = False THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'ERROR : the last line of a failed run stands out in the log.'
    SET txt_EndLevel TO $'''ERROR'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'Last line of the run : status, counts, retries, duration and report paths in one line.'
CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: in_glob_txt_LogLevel in_loc_txt_Level: txt_EndLevel in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Main''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Run ended %txt_RunStatus% in %txt_RunSeconds% s : %num_ItemsHandled% / %num_ItemsRead% item(s), %num_Success% success, %num_BusinessExceptions% business, %num_SystemExceptions% system, %num_Retries% retries ; report %txt_ReportCsv% and %txt_ReportHtml%''' out_loc_txt_Status=> _txt_LogStatus
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

```text
# ===== Tests (global): one case per local function and per recovery path, PASS / FAIL lines written as they run =====
# Run: right-click the first action > Run from here with default values. Each case states the values it expects.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Fixtures : every case works in its own folder under C:\\Temp, nothing of a real project is touched.'
**REGION 1. Fixtures : a fresh test root, the report file, fixed work items
@@CustomNote: 'The report accumulates the PASS / FAIL lines ; Verify also writes each line to the file at once.'
SET txt_Report TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'The stamp separates two test runs : their folders and reports never mix.'
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_Now
@@CustomNote: 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss : sorts in time order in the Temp folder.'
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: date_Now CustomFormat: $'''yyyyMMdd-HHmmss''' Result=> txt_Stamp
@@CustomNote: 'A fresh root per test run : the folder creation cases always start from nothing.'
SET txt_TestRoot TO $'''C:\\Temp\\PAD_REF_Tests\\%txt_Stamp%'''
@@CustomNote: 'One report file per test run, kept as the proof of the run.'
SET txt_TestReportFile TO $'''C:\\Temp\\tests-PAD_REF-%txt_Stamp%.txt'''
@@CustomNote: 'A path whose drive folder does not exist : every recovery case uses it to force a failure.'
SET txt_UnreachableFile TO $'''C:\\PAD_REF_does_not_exist\\missing\\file.txt'''
@@CustomNote: 'Fixed work items covering the three outcomes : one success, three business rules broken, one file name Windows refuses.'
Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { ^['Reference', 'Customer', 'Amount', 'Email'], ['T-001', 'Contoso', '1250', 'ap@contoso.com'], ['T-002', 'Fabrikam', '-10', 'billing@fabrikam.com'], ['T-003', 'Northwind', 'abc', 'finance.northwind@example.com'], ['T-004', 'Tailspin', '300', 'no-email'], ['T:005', 'Litware', '99', 'ap.litware@example.com'] } DataTable=> tbl_Fixture
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Init_Run : the folders are created even when the parents do not exist, and an empty path is refused.'
**REGION 2. Init_Run : nested folders created, empty project folder refused
# --- Init_Run : a project folder two levels below a missing folder -> every level and the 6 sub-folders created, run id and log file set ---
@@CustomNote: 'The parent of project does not exist yet : proves that every missing level is created (Folder.Create alone refuses).'
CALL Init_Run in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder: $'''%txt_TestRoot%\\project''' in_loc_txt_ProcessName: $'''PAD_REF_Test''' out_loc_txt_RunId=> txt_RunId out_loc_txt_LogFile=> txt_LogFile out_loc_txt_ConfigFile=> txt_ConfigFile out_loc_txt_InputFolder=> txt_InputFolder out_loc_txt_OutputFolder=> txt_OutputFolder out_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder=> txt_EvidenceFolder out_loc_txt_ReportsFolder=> txt_ReportsFolder out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok
@@CustomNote: 'Checked on disk, not only from the Ok flag the function returns.'
SET bool_FolderOk TO False
@@CustomNote: 'The Reports folder is the last one created : if it exists, the six exist.'
IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.Exists Path: txt_ReportsFolder) THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Folder found on disk.'
    SET bool_FolderOk TO True
END
@@CustomNote: 'PASS needs the flag, the folder on disk, a run id and a log file name.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = True AND bool_FolderOk = True AND txt_RunId <> $'''''' AND txt_LogFile <> $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Writes PASS or FAIL with the observed values, so a FAIL explains itself.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Init_Run - nested project folder created, run id and log file set''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% ReportsFolderExists=%bool_FolderOk% RunId=%txt_RunId% LogFile=%txt_LogFile%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Init_Run - recovery : an empty project folder gives Ok = False without exception ---
@@CustomNote: 'Recovery case : an empty project folder must give Ok = False, never a crash.'
CALL Init_Run in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder: $'''''' in_loc_txt_ProcessName: $'''PAD_REF_Test''' out_loc_txt_RunId=> _txt_RunId out_loc_txt_LogFile=> _txt_LogFile out_loc_txt_ConfigFile=> _txt_ConfigFile out_loc_txt_InputFolder=> _txt_InputFolder out_loc_txt_OutputFolder=> _txt_OutputFolder out_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder=> _txt_EvidenceFolder out_loc_txt_ReportsFolder=> _txt_ReportsFolder out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok
@@CustomNote: 'The expected answer is a refusal.'

@@CustomNote: 'A FAIL here would mean a robot that writes to an undefined folder.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Init_Run - recovery : empty project folder -> Ok = False''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Write_Log : a line is written, a line under the minimum level is filtered, an unreachable file fails softly.'
**REGION 3. Write_Log : written, filtered, failed
# --- Write_Log : an INFO line with the minimum level INFO is written, fields separated by ' | ' ---
@@CustomNote: 'The level is given in lower case on purpose : Write_Log must accept info as INFO.'
CALL Write_Log in_loc_txt_LogFile: txt_LogFile in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_MinLevel: $'''INFO''' in_loc_txt_Level: $'''info''' in_loc_txt_Step: $'''Tests''' in_loc_txt_Message: $'''Test line for Write_Log''' out_loc_txt_Status=> txt_LogStatus
@@CustomNote: 'Reset first : a failed read must not leave the content of an earlier case.'

ON ERROR

END

@@CustomNote: 'PASS when the status says WRITTEN and the line is in the file.'

# --- Write_Log : a DEBUG line with the minimum level INFO is filtered ---

@@CustomNote: 'The function must say FILTERED, not WRITTEN and not FAILED.'

@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'

# --- Write_Log - recovery : a log file in a missing folder gives FAILED without exception ---

**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'

SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = False AND num_SettingsRead = 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Load_Config - recovery : wrong header -> Ok = False''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% Rows=%num_SettingsRead% Detail=%txt_Detail%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Load_Config - recovery : a Config.csv in a missing folder cannot be written -> Ok = False ---
@@CustomNote: 'Recovery case : the default file cannot even be written in a missing folder.'
CALL Load_Config in_loc_txt_ConfigFile: txt_UnreachableFile in_loc_txt_Environment: $'''DEV''' out_loc_txt_ConfigJson=> _txt_ConfigJson out_loc_num_SettingsRead=> num_SettingsRead out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_Detail
@@CustomNote: 'The expected answer is a refusal.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = False
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Load_Config - recovery : unreachable config file -> Ok = False''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% Detail=%txt_Detail%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Get_Work_Items : the demo file is created and read, a missing file without demo is refused.'
**REGION 5. Get_Work_Items : demo file created and read, missing file refused
# --- Get_Work_Items : no input file, demo requested -> 6 items, the fifth is INV:005 ---
@@CustomNote: 'Demo mode : the function writes the 6 demo items, then reads them like a real file.'
CALL Get_Work_Items in_loc_txt_InputFile: $'''%txt_InputFolder%\\work-items.csv''' in_loc_bool_CreateDemo: True out_loc_tbl_Items=> tbl_Items out_loc_num_Count=> num_Count out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_Detail
@@CustomNote: 'Reset first : a missing row must not leave a value of an earlier case.'
SET txt_FifthKey TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : indexing a table that is too short would stop the flow, no handler catches it.'
IF num_Count >= 5 THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The fifth row is the one with the refused file name : it proves the order and the content.'
    SET txt_FifthKey TO $'''%tbl_Items[4]['Reference']%'''
END
@@CustomNote: '6 rows and the right fifth key.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = True AND num_Count = 6 AND txt_FifthKey = $'''INV:005'''
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Get_Work_Items - demo file created and read -> 6 items, fifth INV:005''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% Count=%num_Count% Fifth=%txt_FifthKey% Detail=%txt_Detail%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Get_Work_Items - recovery : no input file, no demo -> Ok = False, 0 item ---
@@CustomNote: 'Recovery case : no file and no demo must be an error the caller can test.'
CALL Get_Work_Items in_loc_txt_InputFile: $'''%txt_InputFolder%\\absent.csv''' in_loc_bool_CreateDemo: False out_loc_tbl_Items=> _tbl_Items out_loc_num_Count=> num_Count out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_Detail
@@CustomNote: 'Ok = False and no item.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = False AND num_Count = 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Get_Work_Items - recovery : missing file without demo -> Ok = False''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% Count=%num_Count% Detail=%txt_Detail%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Process_Item : one case per outcome, with the exact reason checked.'
**REGION 6. Process_Item : success, three business exceptions, one system exception
# --- Process_Item : T-001, amount 1250, valid e-mail -> SUCCESS, receipt written ---
@@CustomNote: 'Valid item : the business rules pass and the receipt is written.'
CALL Process_Item in_loc_row_Item: tbl_Fixture[0] in_loc_txt_OutputFolder: txt_OutputFolder in_loc_num_Attempt: 1 out_loc_txt_ItemKey=> txt_ItemKey out_loc_txt_Outcome=> txt_Outcome out_loc_txt_Reason=> txt_Reason out_loc_txt_Result=> txt_Result
@@CustomNote: 'Checked on disk, not only from the outcome.'
SET bool_FileOk TO False
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : an empty path would make the file test fail.'
IF txt_Result <> $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The receipt really exists.'
    IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: txt_Result) THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Receipt found on disk.'
        SET bool_FileOk TO True
    END
END
@@CustomNote: 'SUCCESS, the right key and the file on disk.'
SET bool_Pass TO txt_Outcome = $'''SUCCESS''' AND txt_ItemKey = $'''T-001''' AND bool_FileOk = True
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Process_Item - T-001 valid -> SUCCESS, receipt written''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Key=%txt_ItemKey% Outcome=%txt_Outcome% Reason=%txt_Reason% Result=%txt_Result%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Process_Item : T-002, amount -10 -> BUSINESS_EXCEPTION 'Amount must be positive' ---
@@CustomNote: 'Negative amount : a rule of region 2.1 must stop the item before region 2.2.'
CALL Process_Item in_loc_row_Item: tbl_Fixture[1] in_loc_txt_OutputFolder: txt_OutputFolder in_loc_num_Attempt: 1 out_loc_txt_ItemKey=> txt_ItemKey out_loc_txt_Outcome=> txt_Outcome out_loc_txt_Reason=> txt_Reason out_loc_txt_Result=> txt_Result
@@CustomNote: 'The reason must say why, in words a business user understands.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_Reason TextToFind: $'''must be positive''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Business exception and no result : nothing was written for this item.'
SET bool_Pass TO txt_Outcome = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' AND num_Position >= 0 AND txt_Result = $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Process_Item - T-002 amount -10 -> BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Outcome=%txt_Outcome% Reason=%txt_Reason% Result=%txt_Result%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Process_Item : T-003, amount abc -> BUSINESS_EXCEPTION 'Amount is not a number' ---
@@CustomNote: 'Amount that is not a number : the conversion fails and becomes a business exception, not a crash.'
CALL Process_Item in_loc_row_Item: tbl_Fixture[2] in_loc_txt_OutputFolder: txt_OutputFolder in_loc_num_Attempt: 1 out_loc_txt_ItemKey=> txt_ItemKey out_loc_txt_Outcome=> txt_Outcome out_loc_txt_Reason=> txt_Reason out_loc_txt_Result=> txt_Result
@@CustomNote: 'The reason names the problem.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_Reason TextToFind: $'''not a number''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Business exception expected.'
SET bool_Pass TO txt_Outcome = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' AND num_Position >= 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Process_Item - T-003 amount abc -> BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Outcome=%txt_Outcome% Reason=%txt_Reason%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Process_Item : T-004, e-mail no-email -> BUSINESS_EXCEPTION 'Email is not valid' ---
@@CustomNote: 'E-mail without @ : the regular expression rule rejects it.'
CALL Process_Item in_loc_row_Item: tbl_Fixture[3] in_loc_txt_OutputFolder: txt_OutputFolder in_loc_num_Attempt: 1 out_loc_txt_ItemKey=> txt_ItemKey out_loc_txt_Outcome=> txt_Outcome out_loc_txt_Reason=> txt_Reason out_loc_txt_Result=> txt_Result
@@CustomNote: 'The reason names the problem.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_Reason TextToFind: $'''Email is not valid''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Business exception expected.'
SET bool_Pass TO txt_Outcome = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' AND num_Position >= 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Process_Item - T-004 invalid e-mail -> BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Outcome=%txt_Outcome% Reason=%txt_Reason%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Process_Item : T:005, a file name Windows refuses -> SYSTEM_EXCEPTION with the error message, no exception for the caller ---
@@CustomNote: 'Key with a colon : Windows refuses the receipt name, the action fails inside the BLOCK and becomes a system exception.'
CALL Process_Item in_loc_row_Item: tbl_Fixture[4] in_loc_txt_OutputFolder: txt_OutputFolder in_loc_num_Attempt: 1 out_loc_txt_ItemKey=> txt_ItemKey out_loc_txt_Outcome=> txt_Outcome out_loc_txt_Reason=> txt_Reason out_loc_txt_Result=> txt_Result
@@CustomNote: 'System exception with a reason : the message of the failed action reached the caller.'
SET bool_Pass TO txt_Outcome = $'''SYSTEM_EXCEPTION''' AND txt_Reason <> $'''''' AND txt_ItemKey = $'''T:005'''
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Process_Item - T:005 refused file name -> SYSTEM_EXCEPTION with its message''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Outcome=%txt_Outcome% Reason=%txt_Reason%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Take_Evidence and Close_Applications : a real screenshot and a real process closed.'
**REGION 7. Take_Evidence, Close_Applications : capture written, process closed, empty list
# --- Take_Evidence : a PNG of the primary screen, the refused character of the key replaced ---
@@CustomNote: 'Key with a colon : the file name must replace it, or the screenshot would fail.'
CALL Take_Evidence in_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder: txt_EvidenceFolder in_loc_txt_RunId: txt_RunId in_loc_txt_ItemKey: $'''T:005''' in_loc_num_Attempt: 2 out_loc_txt_File=> txt_EvidenceFile out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok
@@CustomNote: 'Checked on disk.'
SET bool_FileOk TO False
@@CustomNote: 'The PNG exists.'
IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: txt_EvidenceFile) THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'File found on disk.'
    SET bool_FileOk TO True
END
@@CustomNote: 'The refused character became an underscore.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_EvidenceFile TextToFind: $'''_T_005_attempt2.png''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Flag, file and name all right.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = True AND bool_FileOk = True AND num_Position >= 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Take_Evidence - PNG written, key T:005 -> T_005''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% Exists=%bool_FileOk% File=%txt_EvidenceFile%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Close_Applications : a PING started here is closed, a name that is not running is ignored -> 1 closed ---
@@CustomNote: 'A harmless process to close : ping for 60 seconds, hidden.'
System.RunApplication.RunApplication ApplicationPath: $'''ping.exe''' CommandLineArguments: $'''-n 60 127.0.0.1''' WindowStyle: System.ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden ProcessId=> num_PingPid
@@CustomNote: 'Set before the wait, reset by the handler if PING never starts.'
SET bool_PingStarted TO True
@@CustomNote: 'Waits for the process instead of a fixed pause : the case is as fast as the machine.'
WAIT (System.WaitForProcess.ProcessToStart ProcessName: $'''PING''') FOR 10
ON ERROR
    SET bool_PingStarted TO False
END
@@CustomNote: 'A missing name and a running one : only the running one is counted.'
CALL Close_Applications in_loc_txt_ProcessNames: $'''PAD_REF_NO_SUCH_PROCESS, PING''' out_loc_num_Closed=> num_Closed out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok
@@CustomNote: 'Checked from outside the function.'
SET bool_PingGone TO False
@@CustomNote: 'PING must be gone.'
IF (System.IfProcess.ProcessIsNotRunning ProcessName: $'''PING''') THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Process closed.'
    SET bool_PingGone TO True
END
@@CustomNote: 'Started, closed, counted once and really gone.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_PingStarted = True AND bool_Ok = True AND num_Closed = 1 AND bool_PingGone = True
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Close_Applications - running PING closed, absent name ignored -> 1''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''PingStarted=%bool_PingStarted% Pid=%num_PingPid% Ok=%bool_Ok% Closed=%num_Closed% PingGone=%bool_PingGone%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Close_Applications : an empty list closes nothing ---
@@CustomNote: 'An empty list closes nothing and is not an error.'
CALL Close_Applications in_loc_txt_ProcessNames: $'''''' out_loc_num_Closed=> num_Closed out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok
@@CustomNote: '0 closed and Ok.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = True AND num_Closed = 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Close_Applications - empty list -> 0''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% Closed=%num_Closed%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Write_Run_Report, Send_Notification and To_Json_Text.'
**REGION 8. Write_Run_Report, Send_Notification, To_Json_Text
# --- Write_Run_Report : 2 result rows -> CSV read back with 2 rows, HTML with the reason escaped ---
@@CustomNote: 'Two result rows ; the reason contains a < to check the HTML escaping.'
Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { ^['RunId', 'ItemKey', 'Outcome', 'Attempts', 'Reason', 'Result', 'StartedAt', 'DurationMs'], ['R1', 'T-001', 'SUCCESS', 1, '', 'receipt-T-001.txt', '2026-10-18 05:00:00', '12'], ['R1', 'T-002', 'BUSINESS_EXCEPTION', 1, 'Amount <= 0', '', '2026-10-18 05:00:01', '3'] } DataTable=> tbl_ResultsFixture
@@CustomNote: 'Writes the CSV and the HTML of the fixture.'
CALL Write_Run_Report in_loc_tbl_Results: tbl_ResultsFixture in_loc_txt_ReportsFolder: txt_ReportsFolder in_loc_txt_RunId: $'''R1''' in_loc_txt_Title: $'''PAD_REF Tests''' out_loc_txt_CsvFile=> txt_CsvFile out_loc_txt_HtmlFile=> txt_HtmlFile out_loc_txt_Html=> txt_Html out_loc_bool_Ok=> bool_Ok
@@CustomNote: '-1 until the CSV is read back.'
SET num_RowsBack TO -1
@@CustomNote: 'Reads the CSV only when it was written.'
IF bool_Ok = True THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Read back like Excel or Power BI would read it.'
    File.ReadFromCSVFile.ReadCSV CSVFile: txt_CsvFile Encoding: File.CSVEncoding.UTF8 TrimFields: True FirstLineContainsColumnNames: True ColumnsSeparator: File.CSVColumnsSeparator.Semicolon CSVTable=> tbl_Back
    @@CustomNote: 'Rows found in the CSV.'
    SET num_RowsBack TO tbl_Back.RowsCount
END
@@CustomNote: 'The < must be escaped, or the HTML table breaks.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_Html TextToFind: $'''Amount &lt;= 0''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Checked on disk.'
SET bool_FileOk TO False
@@CustomNote: 'The HTML file exists.'
IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: txt_HtmlFile) THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'File found on disk.'
    SET bool_FileOk TO True
END
@@CustomNote: 'CSV rows, escaping and HTML file all right.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Ok = True AND num_RowsBack = 2 AND num_Position >= 0 AND bool_FileOk = True
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Write_Run_Report - CSV 2 rows read back, HTML file written, reason escaped''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Ok=%bool_Ok% RowsBack=%num_RowsBack% Position=%num_Position% HtmlExists=%bool_FileOk% Csv=%txt_CsvFile%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Send_Notification : channel NONE -> nothing sent, detail says disabled ---
@@CustomNote: 'Channel none in lower case : disabled, nothing sent, Outlook never started.'
CALL Send_Notification in_loc_txt_Channel: $'''none''' in_loc_txt_To: $'''someone@example.com''' in_loc_txt_Account: $'''''' in_loc_txt_Subject: $'''Test''' in_loc_txt_HtmlBody: $'''<p>Test</p>''' out_loc_bool_Sent=> bool_Sent out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_Detail
@@CustomNote: 'The detail must say disabled.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_Detail TextToFind: $'''disabled''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Not sent and explained.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Sent = False AND num_Position >= 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Send_Notification - NONE -> not sent, disabled''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Sent=%bool_Sent% Detail=%txt_Detail%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- Send_Notification - recovery : OUTLOOK_DRAFT without recipient -> not sent, Outlook never started ---
@@CustomNote: 'Recovery case : a channel without recipient must not open Outlook.'
CALL Send_Notification in_loc_txt_Channel: $'''OUTLOOK_DRAFT''' in_loc_txt_To: $'''''' in_loc_txt_Account: $'''''' in_loc_txt_Subject: $'''Test''' in_loc_txt_HtmlBody: $'''<p>Test</p>''' out_loc_bool_Sent=> bool_Sent out_loc_txt_Detail=> txt_Detail
@@CustomNote: 'The detail names the missing setting.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_Detail TextToFind: $'''NotifyTo is empty''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_Position
@@CustomNote: 'Not sent and explained.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_Sent = False AND num_Position >= 0
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''Send_Notification - recovery : no recipient -> not sent''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''Sent=%bool_Sent% Detail=%txt_Detail%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
# --- To_Json_Text : backslashes and double quotes escaped -> the JSON reads back the original text ---
@@CustomNote: 'Backslashes and quotes : the two characters that break a JSON value.'
SET txt_Original TO $'''C:\\RPA\\PAD_REF \"quoted\"'''
@@CustomNote: 'Escapes the text for a JSON string.'
CALL To_Json_Text in_loc_txt_Text: txt_Original out_loc_txt_Json=> txt_JsonValue
@@CustomNote: 'Reset by the handler if the JSON is invalid.'
SET bool_JsonOk TO True
@@CustomNote: 'Builds a JSON with the escaped value and parses it : the real proof of the escaping.'
Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: $'''{\"value\": \"%txt_JsonValue%\"}''' CustomObject=> obj_Json
ON ERROR
    SET bool_JsonOk TO False
END
@@CustomNote: 'Reset first.'
SET txt_ReadBack TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Read only when the JSON parsed.'
IF bool_JsonOk = True THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The value read back from the JSON.'
    SET txt_ReadBack TO obj_Json['value']
END
@@CustomNote: 'Valid JSON and the original text read back.'
SET bool_Pass TO bool_JsonOk = True AND txt_ReadBack = txt_Original
@@CustomNote: 'Records the result of the case.'
CALL Verify in_loc_txt_Case: $'''To_Json_Text - backslashes and quotes escaped, JSON reads back the original''' in_loc_bool_Ok: bool_Pass in_loc_txt_Detail: $'''JsonOk=%bool_JsonOk% Escaped=%txt_JsonValue% ReadBack=%txt_ReadBack%''' in_loc_txt_ReportIn: txt_Report in_loc_txt_ReportFile: txt_TestReportFile out_loc_txt_Report=> txt_Report
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Total : one line with the number of PASS and FAIL at the end of the report.'
**REGION 9. Total : PASS and FAIL counted from the report
@@CustomNote: 'Counts the PASS lines of the report.'
Text.ParseText.RegexParse Text: txt_Report TextToFind: $'''(?m)^PASS - ''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False Matches=> lst_Pass
@@CustomNote: 'Counts the FAIL lines of the report.'
Text.ParseText.RegexParse Text: txt_Report TextToFind: $'''(?m)^FAIL - ''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False Matches=> lst_Fail
@@CustomNote: 'The line a person reads first.'
SET txt_Total TO $'''TOTAL : %lst_Pass.Count% PASS, %lst_Fail.Count% FAIL'''
@@CustomNote: 'Appended to the report file : the proof of the test run.'
File.WriteText File: txt_TestReportFile TextToWrite: txt_Total AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

**`Verify`** *(optional)* ← [`flow/3-Verify.txt`](flow/3-Verify.txt). Check: 12 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (12 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Verify
# inputs: in_loc_txt_Case, in_loc_bool_Ok, in_loc_txt_Detail, in_loc_txt_ReportIn, in_loc_txt_ReportFile
# outputs: out_loc_txt_Report
# Appends a PASS / FAIL line to the report and writes it to the report file at once, so a case that stops the flow loses nothing.
@@CustomNote: 'One verdict per case : the caller computed the boolean, Verify only formats and records it.'
IF in_loc_bool_Ok = True THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'PASS lines are short : the case name is enough.'
    SET txt_ReportLine TO $'''PASS - %in_loc_txt_Case%'''
ELSE
    @@CustomNote: 'A FAIL line carries the observed values : the failure explains itself without a new run.'
    SET txt_ReportLine TO $'''FAIL - %in_loc_txt_Case% : %in_loc_txt_Detail%'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'The report is returned to the caller so the total can be counted at the end.'
Text.AppendLine Text: in_loc_txt_ReportIn LineToAppend: txt_ReportLine Result=> out_loc_txt_Report
@@CustomNote: 'Written at once, in append : a case that stops the harness loses none of the lines before it.'
File.WriteText File: in_loc_txt_ReportFile TextToWrite: txt_ReportLine AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
@@CustomNote: 'Also sent to the Power Automate run log : a test run can be read without opening the file.'
Logging.LogMessage Message: txt_ReportLine LogLevel: Logging.LogLevel.InfoLevel
```

</details>

**`Init_Run`** ← [`flow/4-Init_Run.txt`](flow/4-Init_Run.txt). Check: 48 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (48 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Init_Run
# inputs: in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder, in_loc_txt_ProcessName
# outputs: out_loc_txt_RunId, out_loc_txt_LogFile, out_loc_txt_ConfigFile, out_loc_txt_InputFolder, out_loc_txt_OutputFolder, out_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder, out_loc_txt_ReportsFolder, out_loc_bool_Ok
# Init_Run: creates the project folders (an existing folder is kept), builds the run id (stamp + machine) and the daily log file name. Never throws.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail : the caller always receives defined values.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic flag, set to False by any failure below.'
SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO True
@@CustomNote: 'Empty until the run id is built in region 3.'
SET out_loc_txt_RunId TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Empty until the log file name is built in region 3.'
SET out_loc_txt_LogFile TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'The folder layout is fixed : every process built from the template looks the same on disk.'
SET out_loc_txt_ConfigFile TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder%\\Config\\Config.csv'''
@@CustomNote: 'Input : where the work items arrive.'
SET out_loc_txt_InputFolder TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder%\\Input'''
@@CustomNote: 'Output : what the process produces (files, receipts).'
SET out_loc_txt_OutputFolder TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder%\\Output'''
@@CustomNote: 'Evidence : screenshots taken on system exceptions.'
SET out_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder%\\Evidence'''
@@CustomNote: 'Reports : the CSV and HTML report of each run.'
SET out_loc_txt_ReportsFolder TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder%\\Reports'''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : without a project folder nothing can be created safely.'
**REGION 2. Guard : a project folder is required
@@CustomNote: 'An empty path would create folders at the root of the current drive.'
IF in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Refused : the caller turns this into a FATAL run with a clear message.'
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves the function with the outputs already set.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Run id and log file : names that a person and a script can both read.'
**REGION 3. Run id and log file : one id per run, one log file per day and per process
@@CustomNote: 'One clock reading for the whole id : stamp and day cannot disagree.'
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_Now
@@CustomNote: 'Sortable stamp, first part of the run id.'
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: date_Now CustomFormat: $'''yyyyMMdd-HHmmss''' Result=> txt_Stamp
@@CustomNote: 'Day of the log file : one file per day and per process.'
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: date_Now CustomFormat: $'''yyyy-MM-dd''' Result=> txt_Day
@@CustomNote: 'Fallback when the machine name cannot be read.'
SET txt_Machine TO $'''PC'''
@@CustomNote: 'The machine name in the run id tells on which robot machine a run happened.'
System.GetEnvironmentVariable.GetEnvironmentVariable Name: $'''COMPUTERNAME''' Value=> txt_Machine
ON ERROR
    SET txt_Machine TO $'''PC'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'Run id = time + machine : unique for a robot that never runs twice in the same second.'
SET out_loc_txt_RunId TO $'''%txt_Stamp%-%txt_Machine%'''
@@CustomNote: 'One log file per day and per process, under Logs.'
SET out_loc_txt_LogFile TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder%\\Logs\\%txt_Day%_%in_loc_txt_ProcessName%.log'''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Folders : created when missing, existing ones are kept, so Init_Run can run before every run.'
**REGION 4. Folders : the project folder and its missing parents, then the 6 sub-folders - an existing folder is kept
# Folder.Create needs an existing parent : every missing level of a drive path is created from the drive down (a share path must exist)
@@CustomNote: 'The path is split on backslashes to create each missing level from the drive down.'
Text.SplitText.SplitWithDelimiter Text: in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder CustomDelimiter: $'''\\''' IsRegEx: False Result=> lst_Levels
@@CustomNote: 'A share path (\\\\server\\share) starts with an empty level : its root must already exist.'
IF lst_Levels[0] <> $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Starts from the drive (C:).'
    SET txt_Parent TO lst_Levels[0]
    @@CustomNote: 'One pass per level below the drive.'
    LOOP num_Level FROM 1 TO lst_Levels.Count - 1 STEP 1
        @@CustomNote: 'The folder level handled in this pass.'
        SET txt_Level TO lst_Levels[num_Level]
        @@CustomNote: 'A trailing backslash gives an empty level : skipped.'
        IF txt_Level <> $'''''' THEN
            @@CustomNote: 'Only a missing level is created.'
            IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.DoesNotExist Path: $'''%txt_Parent%\\%txt_Level%''') THEN
                @@CustomNote: 'Folder.Create needs an existing parent (measured on PAD 2.73) : this is why the levels are created one by one.'
                Folder.Create FolderPath: $'''%txt_Parent%\\''' FolderName: txt_Level Folder=> _fold_Level
                ON ERROR
                    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
                END
            END
            @@CustomNote: 'The next level is created under this one.'
            SET txt_Parent TO $'''%txt_Parent%\\%txt_Level%'''
        END
    END
END
@@CustomNote: 'The six sub-folders every process of the framework uses.'
LOOP FOREACH txt_SubFolder IN ['Config', 'Input', 'Output', 'Logs', 'Evidence', 'Reports']
    @@CustomNote: 'Creating a folder that exists is harmless ; a failure sets Ok to False without stopping the robot.'
    Folder.Create FolderPath: in_loc_txt_ProjectFolder FolderName: txt_SubFolder Folder=> _fold_Created
    ON ERROR
        SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
    END
END
**ENDREGION
```

**`Write_Log`** ← [`flow/5-Write_Log.txt`](flow/5-Write_Log.txt). Check: 33 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (33 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Write_Log
# inputs: in_loc_txt_LogFile, in_loc_txt_RunId, in_loc_txt_MinLevel, in_loc_txt_Level, in_loc_txt_Step, in_loc_txt_Message
# outputs: out_loc_txt_Status
# Write_Log: one line per event, filtered by level (DEBUG < INFO < WARN < ERROR < FATAL) ; WARN and above also go to the run log of Power Automate. Status WRITTEN, FILTERED or FAILED, never an exception.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Levels are ranked by their position in one text : simple, and no table to maintain.'
**REGION 1. Output and level ranks : the rank of a level is its position in the ordered list
@@CustomNote: 'FILTERED until the line is really written.'
SET out_loc_txt_Status TO $'''FILTERED'''
@@CustomNote: 'Upper case : callers may write info or INFO.'
Text.ChangeCase Text: in_loc_txt_Level NewCase: Text.CaseOption.UpperCase Result=> txt_Level
@@CustomNote: 'Upper case for the minimum level too.'
Text.ChangeCase Text: in_loc_txt_MinLevel NewCase: Text.CaseOption.UpperCase Result=> txt_MinLevel
@@CustomNote: 'Rank of the line : 0 DEBUG, 6 INFO, 11 WARN, 16 ERROR, 22 FATAL.'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: $'''DEBUG INFO WARN ERROR FATAL''' TextToFind: txt_Level StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_LevelRank
@@CustomNote: 'Rank of the minimum level asked by the run (input in_glob_txt_LogLevel).'
Text.ParseText.ParseForFirstOccurrence Text: $'''DEBUG INFO WARN ERROR FATAL''' TextToFind: txt_MinLevel StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> num_MinRank
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : a line below the minimum level costs nothing.'
**REGION 2. Guard : a line below the minimum level is not written ; an unknown minimum level means INFO
@@CustomNote: 'An unknown minimum level must not silence the log.'
IF num_MinRank < 0 THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Falls back to INFO, the usual production level.'
    SET num_MinRank TO 6
END
@@CustomNote: 'Below the minimum level : not written, and not an error.'
IF num_LevelRank < num_MinRank THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with the status FILTERED.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Output : one line per event, the same layout in every process.'
**REGION 3. Output : one line, fields separated by ' | ', the message kept on one line
@@CustomNote: 'Time of the event.'
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> date_Now
@@CustomNote: 'Milliseconds : orders events that happen in the same second.'
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: date_Now CustomFormat: $'''yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff''' Result=> txt_Time
@@CustomNote: 'The message is kept on one line : a line break would break every script that reads the log.'
Text.Replace.ReplaceTextWithRegex Text: in_loc_txt_Message TextToFind: $'''\\s*[\\r\\n]+\\s*''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $''' / ''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> txt_Message
@@CustomNote: 'time | run id | level | step | message : readable by a person, split by a script on the pipe.'
SET txt_Line TO $'''%txt_Time% | %in_loc_txt_RunId% | %txt_Level% | %in_loc_txt_Step% | %txt_Message%'''
@@CustomNote: 'WRITTEN unless the write fails just below.'
SET out_loc_txt_Status TO $'''WRITTEN'''
@@CustomNote: 'Append : one file per day keeps every run of the day.'
File.WriteText File: in_loc_txt_LogFile TextToWrite: txt_Line AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_txt_Status TO $'''FAILED'''
END
# ERROR and FATAL (rank 16 and more), WARN (rank 11) : visible in the run details of Power Automate without opening the log file
@@CustomNote: 'ERROR and FATAL also reach Power Automate : visible in the run details of the cloud flow without opening the log file.'
IF num_LevelRank >= 16 THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Logged as an error in Power Automate.'
    Logging.LogMessage Message: txt_Line LogLevel: Logging.LogLevel.ErrorLevel
ELSE IF num_LevelRank >= 11 THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'WARN : logged as a warning in Power Automate.'
    Logging.LogMessage Message: txt_Line LogLevel: Logging.LogLevel.WarningLevel
END
**ENDREGION
```

</details>
