```text
# local subflow: Load_Config
# inputs: in_loc_txt_ConfigFile, in_loc_txt_Environment
# outputs: out_loc_txt_ConfigJson, out_loc_num_SettingsRead, out_loc_bool_Ok, out_loc_txt_Detail
# Load_Config: defaults, then the rows of Config.csv for every environment ('*'), then the rows of the current environment (they win).
# Every framework key always exists, so Main never reads a missing key. A missing Config.csv is created with the defaults. Never throws.
# TEMPLATE: add the default of every business setting in region 2, so the key exists even when Config.csv does not list it.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail
@@CustomNote: 'An empty JSON object until the settings are built.'
SET out_loc_txt_ConfigJson TO $'''{}'''
@@CustomNote: 'Number of Config.csv rows applied : the tests check it to prove the environment logic.'
SET out_loc_num_SettingsRead TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic flag, set to False by any failure below.'
SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO True
@@CustomNote: 'Explains a refusal in words a maker understands.'
SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Upper case : dev, Dev and DEV select the same rows.'
Text.ChangeCase Text: in_loc_txt_Environment NewCase: Text.CaseOption.UpperCase Result=> txt_Environment
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Defaults : every key Main reads exists, even when Config.csv does not list it ; no missing key can stop the flow.'
**REGION 2. Defaults : every key Main reads, with its value when Config.csv is silent
@@CustomNote: 'An empty object, filled key by key.'
SET obj_Config TO {{ }}
@@CustomNote: 'Retries after a system exception : 2 means up to 3 attempts per item.'
SET obj_Config['MaxRetryNumber'] TO $'''2'''
@@CustomNote: 'Circuit breaker : 5 system exceptions in a row stop the run.'
SET obj_Config['MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions'] TO $'''5'''
@@CustomNote: 'Seconds to wait before a retry.'
SET obj_Config['RetryDelaySeconds'] TO $'''2'''
@@CustomNote: 'Screenshots on by default : the first thing support asks for.'
SET obj_Config['ScreenshotOnSystemException'] TO $'''True'''
@@CustomNote: 'No application closed by default : each process lists its own.'
SET obj_Config['ProcessesToClose'] TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Name of the work items file in the Input folder.'
SET obj_Config['InputFile'] TO $'''work-items.csv'''
@@CustomNote: 'Demo on in the template so it runs out of the box ; a real process sets it to False.'
SET obj_Config['CreateDemoInput'] TO $'''True'''
@@CustomNote: 'No e-mail by default : a template must never write to anyone by surprise.'
SET obj_Config['NotifyChannel'] TO $'''NONE'''
@@CustomNote: 'No recipient by default.'
SET obj_Config['NotifyTo'] TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'No sending account by default.'
SET obj_Config['NotifyAccount'] TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Successful runs are quiet by default.'
SET obj_Config['NotifyOnSuccess'] TO $'''False'''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : a missing Config.csv is created with the defaults, so a new process starts with a complete, documented file.'
**REGION 3. Guard : a missing Config.csv is written with the defaults, editable in Excel (separator ;)
@@CustomNote: 'Only when the file does not exist : an existing configuration is never overwritten.'
IF (File.IfFile.DoesNotExist File: in_loc_txt_ConfigFile) THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Every setting with its value, its environment (* for all) and a description a maker can read in Excel.'
    Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { ^['Name', 'Value', 'Environment', 'Description'], ['MaxRetryNumber', '2', '*', 'Retries of an item after a system exception (attempts = 1 + retries)'], ['MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions', '5', '*', 'The run stops after this many system exceptions in a row'], ['RetryDelaySeconds', '2', '*', 'Pause before a retry, after the recovery'], ['ScreenshotOnSystemException', 'True', '*', 'Screenshot in the Evidence folder on every system exception'], ['ProcessesToClose', '', '*', 'Process names closed at start, before a retry and at the end, comma separated (EXCEL,msedge)'], ['InputFile', 'work-items.csv', '*', 'Work items file in the Input folder (separator ; and a header line)'], ['CreateDemoInput', 'True', '*', 'Creates a demo work items file when it is missing - set False in a real process'], ['NotifyChannel', 'NONE', '*', 'NONE, OUTLOOK_DRAFT or OUTLOOK_SEND'], ['NotifyTo', '', '*', 'Recipients of the run report'], ['NotifyAccount', '', '*', 'Outlook account that sends the report'], ['NotifyOnSuccess', 'False', '*', 'Also notify when every item succeeded'], ['MaxRetryNumber', '1', 'PROD', 'Example of an environment override - fewer retries in PROD'] } DataTable=> tbl_Defaults
    @@CustomNote: 'Separator ; and UTF-8 : the file opens correctly in a French or English Excel.'
    File.WriteToCSVFile.WriteCSV VariableToWrite: tbl_Defaults CSVFile: in_loc_txt_ConfigFile CsvFileEncoding: File.CSVEncoding.UTF8 IncludeColumnNames: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Overwrite ColumnsSeparator: File.CSVColumnsSeparator.Semicolon
    ON ERROR
        SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
        SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Config file missing and the default one could not be written: %in_loc_txt_ConfigFile%'''
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'A configuration that cannot be written cannot be read either.'
    IF out_loc_bool_Ok = False THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with Ok = False and a detail.'
        EXIT FUNCTION
    END
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#C6E0B4'
@@CustomNote: 'Input : the header is checked before any column is read, because a missing column stops a flow and no handler catches it.'
**REGION 4. Input : the header is checked before any column is read (a missing column stops a flow, no handler catches it)
@@CustomNote: 'Read as text first, only to check the header.'
File.ReadTextFromFile.ReadText File: in_loc_txt_ConfigFile Encoding: File.TextFileEncoding.UTF8 Content=> txt_ConfigText
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Config file could not be read: %in_loc_txt_ConfigFile%'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'An unreadable file is refused with its path.'
IF out_loc_bool_Ok = False THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with Ok = False and a detail.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
@@CustomNote: '\\W* skips the byte order mark Excel may write before the first column name.'
Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: txt_ConfigText TextToFind: $'''^\\W*Name;Value;Environment''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True Match=> txt_Header OccurrencePosition=> _num_HeaderPosition
@@CustomNote: 'Wrong header : refused before any row is read.'
IF txt_Header = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Refused.'
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
    @@CustomNote: 'The detail tells exactly what the first line must be.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''The first line of %in_loc_txt_ConfigFile% must start with Name;Value;Environment'''
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves without reading any column.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
@@CustomNote: 'The whole file in one action, as a table.'
File.ReadFromCSVFile.ReadCSV CSVFile: in_loc_txt_ConfigFile Encoding: File.CSVEncoding.UTF8 TrimFields: True FirstLineContainsColumnNames: True ColumnsSeparator: File.CSVColumnsSeparator.Semicolon CSVTable=> tbl_Config
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Config file is not a valid CSV: %in_loc_txt_ConfigFile%'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'A file that is not a CSV is refused.'
IF out_loc_bool_Ok = False THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with Ok = False and a detail.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Processing : two passes, so a row of the current environment wins wherever it sits in the file.'
**REGION 5. Processing : rows for every environment first, then the rows of the current environment, which win
@@CustomNote: 'First pass : the rows for every environment.'
LOOP FOREACH row_Setting IN tbl_Config
    @@CustomNote: 'Read as text : an empty cell must not stop the flow.'
    SET txt_RowEnvironment TO $'''%row_Setting['Environment']%'''
    @@CustomNote: '* or empty means every environment.'
    IF txt_RowEnvironment = $'''*''' OR txt_RowEnvironment = $'''''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'The setting name, as text.'
        SET txt_Key TO $'''%row_Setting['Name']%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Dynamic key : any setting of the file becomes a key, business settings included.'
        SET obj_Config[txt_Key] TO $'''%row_Setting['Value']%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Counted for the tests.'
        SET out_loc_num_SettingsRead TO out_loc_num_SettingsRead + 1
    END
END
@@CustomNote: 'Second pass : the rows of the current environment override the common ones.'
LOOP FOREACH row_Setting IN tbl_Config
    @@CustomNote: 'Upper case, like the environment received.'
    Text.ChangeCase Text: $'''%row_Setting['Environment']%''' NewCase: Text.CaseOption.UpperCase Result=> txt_RowEnvironment
    @@CustomNote: 'Only the rows of this environment.'
    IF txt_RowEnvironment = txt_Environment THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'The setting name, as text.'
        SET txt_Key TO $'''%row_Setting['Name']%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Replaces the common value.'
        SET obj_Config[txt_Key] TO $'''%row_Setting['Value']%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Counted for the tests.'
        SET out_loc_num_SettingsRead TO out_loc_num_SettingsRead + 1
    END
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : the numbers are checked here, so Main converts them without a handler.'
**REGION 6. Guard : numeric settings are numbers, so Main converts them without a handler
@@CustomNote: 'The three settings Main converts to numbers.'
LOOP FOREACH txt_NumericKey IN ['MaxRetryNumber', 'MaxConsecutiveSystemExceptions', 'RetryDelaySeconds']
    @@CustomNote: 'A text in place of a number is caught here, with the name of the key in the detail.'
    Text.ToNumber Text: obj_Config[txt_NumericKey] Number=> _num_Checked
    ON ERROR
        SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
        SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Setting %txt_NumericKey% is not a number: %obj_Config[txt_NumericKey]%'''
    END
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Output : the settings leave as JSON text, the type that crosses the boundary of a local subflow.'
**REGION 7. Output : the effective settings as JSON text (a text crosses the boundary of a local subflow)
@@CustomNote: 'Main turns the JSON back into an object, once.'
Variables.ConvertCustomObjectToJson CustomObject: obj_Config Json=> out_loc_txt_ConfigJson
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

# inputs: in_loc_txt_InputFile, in_loc_bool_CreateDemo
# outputs: out_loc_tbl_Items, out_loc_num_Count, out_loc_bool_Ok, out_loc_txt_Detail
# Get_Work_Items: reads every work item once, as a table (one row = one transaction). Never throws.
# TEMPLATE: replace region 3 by the real source (Excel, SQL, API, export of a business application), give region 1 the columns of that source and remove the demo part of region 2 ; keep one row per item.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail

Variables.CreateNewDatatable InputTable: { ^['Reference', 'Customer', 'Amount', 'Email'] } DataTable=> out_loc_tbl_Items
@@CustomNote: '0 until the file is read.'

    @@CustomNote: 'Written like any input file : the demo exercises the real read below.'

    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Demo input file created (CreateDemoInput = True).'''
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#C6E0B4'
@@CustomNote: 'Input : the whole file in one action ; replace this region to plug another source (Excel, SQL, API).'

**`Process_Item`** ← [`flow/8-Process_Item.txt`](flow/8-Process_Item.txt). Check: 45 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (45 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Process_Item
# inputs: in_loc_row_Item, in_loc_txt_OutputFolder, in_loc_num_Attempt
# outputs: out_loc_txt_ItemKey, out_loc_txt_Outcome, out_loc_txt_Reason, out_loc_txt_Result
# Process_Item: ONE transaction. A rule broken by the data is a BUSINESS_EXCEPTION (final, never retried) ;
# an unexpected failure of an action is a SYSTEM_EXCEPTION (Main closes the applications and retries). Never throws.
# TEMPLATE: replace regions 2.1 (business rules) and 2.2 (application steps) by the real process, and the key column read in region 1 ; keep the rest of regions 1, 2 and 3.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail : Main always receives a key and an outcome.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail
@@CustomNote: 'The item key, read first : logs, report and screenshots name the item even if everything else fails.'
SET out_loc_txt_ItemKey TO $'''%in_loc_row_Item['Reference']%'''
@@CustomNote: 'SUCCESS unless a rule or an action says otherwise below.'
SET out_loc_txt_Outcome TO $'''SUCCESS'''
@@CustomNote: 'Empty for a success ; the reason of an exception otherwise.'
SET out_loc_txt_Reason TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'What the transaction produced (a file, a draft, an id), quoted in the log and the report.'
SET out_loc_txt_Result TO $''''''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Transaction : one item, protected by a BLOCK so a failing action becomes an outcome, never a crash.'
**REGION 2. Transaction : any unexpected error inside is a system exception
@@CustomNote: 'Its handler only sets SYSTEM_EXCEPTION : Main decides to retry, to give up or to stop the run.'
BLOCK Transaction
ON BLOCK ERROR
    SET out_loc_txt_Outcome TO $'''SYSTEM_EXCEPTION'''
END
    @@regionColor: '#BDD7EE'
    @@CustomNote: 'Business rules : TEMPLATE - replace with your rules ; each broken rule gives a business exception and its reason.'
    **REGION 2.1 Business rules : a rule broken by the data is a business exception, never retried
    @@CustomNote: 'Rule 1 : the amount must be a number ; its own handler turns a failed conversion into a business exception.'
    Text.ToNumber Text: in_loc_row_Item['Amount'] Number=> num_Amount
    ON ERROR
        SET out_loc_txt_Outcome TO $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION'''
        SET out_loc_txt_Reason TO $'''Amount is not a number: %in_loc_row_Item['Amount']%'''
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'A broken rule ends the transaction at once : the application steps never run on bad data.'
    IF out_loc_txt_Outcome = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with the business exception and its reason.'
        EXIT FUNCTION
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'Rule 2 : a negative or zero amount is a data error, not a technical one.'
    IF num_Amount <= 0 THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Business exception : never retried, the business team corrects the data.'
        SET out_loc_txt_Outcome TO $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION'''
        @@CustomNote: 'The reason quotes the value : the business user sees what is wrong.'
        SET out_loc_txt_Reason TO $'''Amount must be positive: %num_Amount%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Leaves before the application steps.'
        EXIT FUNCTION
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'Rule 3 : the e-mail must look like an e-mail (one @, a dot in the domain).'
    Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: in_loc_row_Item['Email'] TextToFind: $'''^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: True Match=> txt_EmailMatch OccurrencePosition=> _num_EmailPosition
    @@CustomNote: 'No match : the e-mail is not valid.'
    IF txt_EmailMatch = $'''''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Business exception.'
        SET out_loc_txt_Outcome TO $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION'''
        @@CustomNote: 'The reason quotes the value.'
        SET out_loc_txt_Reason TO $'''Email is not valid: %in_loc_row_Item['Email']%'''
        @@CustomNote: 'Leaves before the application steps.'
        EXIT FUNCTION
    END
    **ENDREGION
    @@regionColor: '#BDD7EE'
    @@CustomNote: 'Application steps : TEMPLATE - replace with the real work in your applications ; no handler here on purpose.'
    **REGION 2.2 Application steps : the work itself - the demo writes one receipt per item
    # No handler here on purpose : a failed action is a system exception (the demo item INV:005 is a file name Windows refuses)
    @@CustomNote: 'The demo writes one receipt per item ; a key Windows refuses in a file name triggers the system exception path.'
    SET txt_ReceiptFile TO $'''%in_loc_txt_OutputFolder%\\receipt-%out_loc_txt_ItemKey%.txt'''
    @@CustomNote: 'A failure here (file name, locked file, application down) jumps to the BLOCK handler : SYSTEM_EXCEPTION, retried by Main.'
    File.WriteText File: txt_ReceiptFile TextToWrite: $'''Receipt %out_loc_txt_ItemKey% | customer %in_loc_row_Item['Customer']% | amount %num_Amount% | attempt %in_loc_num_Attempt%''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Overwrite Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
    @@CustomNote: 'The result is quoted in the log and the report.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Result TO txt_ReceiptFile
    **ENDREGION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'System exception : the reason must say which action failed and why.'
**REGION 3. System exception : the message of the failed action, on one line, for the log and the report
@@CustomNote: 'Only after a failure caught by the BLOCK.'
IF out_loc_txt_Outcome = $'''SYSTEM_EXCEPTION''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Get last error : subflow, action number, action name, error message and details.'
    ERROR => txt_LastError
    @@CustomNote: 'On one line : the reason goes into a log line and a CSV cell.'
    Text.Replace.ReplaceTextWithRegex Text: txt_LastError TextToFind: $'''\\s*[\\r\\n]+\\s*''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $''' / ''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> out_loc_txt_Reason
END
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

**`Take_Evidence`** ← [`flow/9-Take_Evidence.txt`](flow/9-Take_Evidence.txt). Check: 12 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (12 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Take_Evidence
# inputs: in_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder, in_loc_txt_RunId, in_loc_txt_ItemKey, in_loc_num_Attempt
# outputs: out_loc_txt_File, out_loc_bool_Ok
# Take_Evidence: a PNG of the primary screen, named after the run, the item and the attempt (characters Windows refuses become _). Never throws.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'The file name is built before the capture : a failed capture still returns the name it tried.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : the file name is built before the capture
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic flag, set to False if the capture fails.'
SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO True
@@CustomNote: 'Characters Windows refuses in a file name become _ : the item INV:005 gives INV_005.'
Text.Replace.ReplaceTextWithRegex Text: in_loc_txt_ItemKey TextToFind: $'''[^A-Za-z0-9_-]''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $'''_''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> txt_SafeKey
@@CustomNote: 'run id + item + attempt : each attempt of each run has its own screenshot, nothing is overwritten.'
SET out_loc_txt_File TO $'''%in_loc_txt_EvidenceFolder%\\%in_loc_txt_RunId%_%txt_SafeKey%_attempt%in_loc_num_Attempt%.png'''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Output : what was on screen when the action failed.'
**REGION 2. Output : the capture
@@CustomNote: 'Primary screen in PNG : sharp text, small files ; a failed capture never stops the robot.'
Workstation.TakeScreenshot.TakeScreenshotOfPrimaryScreenAndSaveToFile File: out_loc_txt_File ImageFormat: System.ImageFormat.Png
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
END
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

**`Close_Applications`** ← [`flow/10-Close_Applications.txt`](flow/10-Close_Applications.txt). Check: 26 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (26 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Close_Applications
# inputs: in_loc_txt_ProcessNames
# outputs: out_loc_num_Closed, out_loc_bool_Ok
# Close_Applications: closes every running process of a comma separated list (EXCEL,msedge) - called at start, before a retry (recovery) and at the end.
# A process that is not running is not an error. Never throws.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail
@@CustomNote: 'Number of processes closed, for the log.'
SET out_loc_num_Closed TO 0
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic flag, set to False if a process refuses to close.'
SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO True
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : no list, nothing to do.'
**REGION 2. Guard : an empty list closes nothing
@@CustomNote: 'ProcessesToClose is empty in the template : each process lists the applications it opens.'
IF in_loc_txt_ProcessNames = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with 0 closed and Ok.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Processing : the same call serves at start (clean desktop), before each retry (recovery) and at the end.'
**REGION 3. Processing : one name after the other, only when the process is running
@@CustomNote: 'The list comes from Config.csv, comma separated (EXCEL,msedge).'
Text.SplitText.SplitWithDelimiter Text: in_loc_txt_ProcessNames CustomDelimiter: $''',''' IsRegEx: False Result=> lst_Names
@@CustomNote: 'One pass per process name.'
LOOP FOREACH txt_Name IN lst_Names
    @@CustomNote: 'Spaces around the commas are tolerated.'
    Text.Trim Text: txt_Name TrimOption: Text.TrimOption.Both TrimmedText=> txt_Process
    @@CustomNote: 'An empty name (double comma) is skipped.'
    IF txt_Process <> $'''''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Only a running process is closed : a closed application is not an error.'
        IF (System.IfProcess.ProcessIsRunning ProcessName: txt_Process) THEN
            @@CustomNote: 'Closes every process of that name : save your own work before a robot runs on your session.'
            System.TerminateProcess.TerminateProcessByName ProcessName: txt_Process
            ON ERROR
                SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
            END
            @@CustomNote: 'Counted for the log.'
            SET out_loc_num_Closed TO out_loc_num_Closed + 1
        END
    END
END
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

**`Write_Run_Report`** ← [`flow/11-Write_Run_Report.txt`](flow/11-Write_Run_Report.txt). Check: 34 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (34 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Write_Run_Report
# inputs: in_loc_tbl_Results, in_loc_txt_ReportsFolder, in_loc_txt_RunId, in_loc_txt_Title
# outputs: out_loc_txt_CsvFile, out_loc_txt_HtmlFile, out_loc_txt_Html, out_loc_bool_Ok
# Write_Run_Report: the result of every item as CSV (one row per item, for Excel or Power BI) and as an HTML page, also the body of the notification. Never throws.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic flag, set to False if a file cannot be written.'
SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO True
@@CustomNote: 'One CSV per run, named after the run id : runs never overwrite each other.'
SET out_loc_txt_CsvFile TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ReportsFolder%\\run-%in_loc_txt_RunId%.csv'''
@@CustomNote: 'The same name for the HTML page.'
SET out_loc_txt_HtmlFile TO $'''%in_loc_txt_ReportsFolder%\\run-%in_loc_txt_RunId%.html'''
@@CustomNote: 'Empty until the page is built.'
SET out_loc_txt_Html TO $''''''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guard : without a folder the report would land at the root of the disk.'
**REGION 2. Guard : a reports folder is required
@@CustomNote: 'Init_Run failed before setting the folder.'
IF in_loc_txt_ReportsFolder = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Refused.'
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves with Ok = False.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'Processing : one HTML row per item, the outcome coloured, for the people who read the report.'
**REGION 3. Processing : one HTML row per item, the outcome coloured
@@CustomNote: 'The rows are accumulated, then inserted once into the page.'
SET txt_Rows TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'One pass per item of the run.'
LOOP FOREACH row_Result IN in_loc_tbl_Results
    @@CustomNote: 'Green by default : most rows of a healthy run are successes, the exceptions stand out.'
    SET txt_Color TO $'''#C6E0B4'''
    @@CustomNote: 'A business exception : the business team must correct the data.'
    IF row_Result['Outcome'] = $'''BUSINESS_EXCEPTION''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Amber : the rows the business team acts on.'
        SET txt_Color TO $'''#FFE699'''
    ELSE IF row_Result['Outcome'] = $'''SYSTEM_EXCEPTION''' THEN
        @@CustomNote: 'Red : the rows the support team looks at (screenshots in Evidence).'
        SET txt_Color TO $'''#F4B6B6'''
    END
    @@CustomNote: 'A < in a reason would break the HTML table : it is escaped.'
    Text.Replace.ReplaceText Text: $'''%row_Result['Reason']%''' TextToFind: $'''<''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $'''&lt;''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False ComparisonType: Text.TextComparisonType.Ordinal Result=> txt_Reason
    @@CustomNote: 'One row : item, outcome, attempts, reason, duration.'
    SET txt_Rows TO $'''%txt_Rows%<tr><td>%row_Result['ItemKey']%</td><td style=\"background:%txt_Color%\">%row_Result['Outcome']%</td><td>%row_Result['Attempts']%</td><td>%txt_Reason%</td><td>%row_Result['DurationMs']%</td></tr>'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'The whole page, also used as the body of the notification e-mail.'
SET out_loc_txt_Html TO $'''<html><body style=\"font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif\"><h2>%in_loc_txt_Title%</h2><p>Run %in_loc_txt_RunId% - %in_loc_tbl_Results.RowsCount% item(s)</p><table border=\"1\" cellpadding=\"4\" style=\"border-collapse:collapse\"><tr><th>Item</th><th>Outcome</th><th>Attempts</th><th>Reason</th><th>Duration (ms)</th></tr>%txt_Rows%</table></body></html>'''
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Output : the CSV for Excel or Power BI, the HTML page for people.'
**REGION 4. Output : the CSV and the HTML page
@@CustomNote: 'Separator ; and UTF-8 with headers : opens in Excel and loads in Power BI as is.'
File.WriteToCSVFile.WriteCSV VariableToWrite: in_loc_tbl_Results CSVFile: out_loc_txt_CsvFile CsvFileEncoding: File.CSVEncoding.UTF8 IncludeColumnNames: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Overwrite ColumnsSeparator: File.CSVColumnsSeparator.Semicolon
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
END
@@CustomNote: 'The page next to the CSV ; a failure is reported, not thrown.'
File.WriteText File: out_loc_txt_HtmlFile TextToWrite: out_loc_txt_Html AppendNewLine: False IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Overwrite Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_bool_Ok TO False
END
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

**`Send_Notification`** ← [`flow/12-Send_Notification.txt`](flow/12-Send_Notification.txt). Check: 37 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (37 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: Send_Notification
# inputs: in_loc_txt_Channel, in_loc_txt_To, in_loc_txt_Account, in_loc_txt_Subject, in_loc_txt_HtmlBody
# outputs: out_loc_bool_Sent, out_loc_txt_Detail
# Send_Notification: the run report by Outlook, as a draft (OUTLOOK_DRAFT) or sent (OUTLOOK_SEND) ; NONE disables it. Outlook is opened and used here only. Never throws.
@@regionColor: '#57FFE1'
@@CustomNote: 'Every output is set before the first action that can fail.'
**REGION 1. Outputs : initialised before the first action that can fail
@@CustomNote: 'False until Outlook accepts the message.'
SET out_loc_bool_Sent TO False
@@CustomNote: 'Says what happened : disabled, refused, draft or sent.'
SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $''''''
@@CustomNote: 'Upper case : none and NONE mean the same.'
Text.ChangeCase Text: in_loc_txt_Channel NewCase: Text.CaseOption.UpperCase Result=> txt_Channel
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#F4B6B6'
@@CustomNote: 'Guards : nothing leaves without an explicit channel and a recipient.'
**REGION 2. Guards : a disabled channel, an unknown channel or no recipient sends nothing
@@CustomNote: 'NONE is the default : a template never writes to anyone by surprise.'
IF txt_Channel = $'''NONE''' OR txt_Channel = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'Disabled, not an error.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Notification disabled (NotifyChannel = NONE)'''
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves without starting Outlook.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
@@CustomNote: 'A typo in the channel is reported instead of guessed.'
IF txt_Channel <> $'''OUTLOOK_DRAFT''' AND txt_Channel <> $'''OUTLOOK_SEND''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The detail lists the accepted values.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Unknown NotifyChannel: %in_loc_txt_Channel% (NONE, OUTLOOK_DRAFT or OUTLOOK_SEND)'''
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves without starting Outlook.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
@@CustomNote: 'No recipient : nothing to send.'
IF in_loc_txt_To = $'''''' THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The detail names the missing setting.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''NotifyTo is empty: nothing sent'''
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves without starting Outlook.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: '#FFD966'
@@CustomNote: 'Output : Outlook is opened and used inside this function, because an instance cannot cross a local subflow.'
**REGION 3. Output : Outlook started (or attached), the message saved as a draft or sent
@@CustomNote: 'OUTLOOK_DRAFT saves a draft a person reviews ; OUTLOOK_SEND sends at once.'
SET bool_Draft TO txt_Channel = $'''OUTLOOK_DRAFT'''
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic flag, set to False if Outlook cannot start.'
SET bool_Launched TO True
@@CustomNote: 'Starts Outlook, or attaches to the Outlook already open on the session.'
Outlook.Launch Instance=> inst_Outlook
ON ERROR
    SET bool_Launched TO False
END
@@CustomNote: 'Outlook unavailable : reported, the run goes on.'
IF bool_Launched = False THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The detail tells the support team why nothing was sent.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Outlook could not be started'''
    @@CustomNote: 'Leaves without a message.'
    EXIT FUNCTION
END
@@CustomNote: 'Optimistic : set back to False if Outlook refuses the message.'
SET out_loc_bool_Sent TO True
@@CustomNote: 'The HTML report as the body ; the account must be one of the Outlook profile.'
Outlook.SendEmailThroughOutlook.SendEmail Instance: inst_Outlook Account: in_loc_txt_Account SendTo: in_loc_txt_To Subject: in_loc_txt_Subject Body: in_loc_txt_HtmlBody IsBodyHtml: True IsDraft: bool_Draft
ON ERROR
    SET out_loc_bool_Sent TO False
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Outlook refused the message (account %in_loc_txt_Account%, to %in_loc_txt_To%)'''
END
@@CustomNote: 'Accepted by Outlook.'
IF out_loc_bool_Sent = True THEN
    @@CustomNote: 'The detail says draft or sent, and to whom.'
    SET out_loc_txt_Detail TO $'''Report %txt_Channel% to %in_loc_txt_To%'''
END
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

**`To_Json_Text`** ← [`flow/13-To_Json_Text.txt`](flow/13-To_Json_Text.txt). Check: 9 lines, Errors pane empty.

<details><summary>The code (9 lines)</summary>

```text
# local subflow: To_Json_Text
# inputs: in_loc_txt_Text
# outputs: out_loc_txt_Json
# To_Json_Text: escapes a text for a JSON string value (backslash, double quote, line breaks and tabs), so the run summary stays valid JSON.
@@regionColor: '#D9C3E9'
@@CustomNote: 'The order matters : backslashes first, otherwise the backslashes added for the quotes would be doubled.'
**REGION 1. Processing : backslash first, then the double quote, then the control characters
@@CustomNote: 'A Windows path is full of backslashes : each one is doubled for JSON.'
Text.Replace.ReplaceText Text: in_loc_txt_Text TextToFind: $'''\\''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $'''\\\\''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False ComparisonType: Text.TextComparisonType.Ordinal Result=> txt_Escaped
@@CustomNote: 'A double quote would end the JSON value : it is escaped.'
Text.Replace.ReplaceText Text: txt_Escaped TextToFind: $'''\"''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $'''\\\"''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False ComparisonType: Text.TextComparisonType.Ordinal Result=> txt_Escaped
@@CustomNote: 'Line breaks and tabs become spaces : the summary stays on one line and valid.'
Text.Replace.ReplaceTextWithRegex Text: txt_Escaped TextToFind: $'''[\\r\\n\\t]+''' IgnoreCase: False ReplaceWith: $''' ''' ActivateEscapeSequences: False Result=> out_loc_txt_Json
**ENDREGION
```

</details>

### 1.4 Run and check

Tab `Main`, **Run**. Expected:

- After about 2 min 30 s in the designer, the run ends without error. `C:\RPA\PAD_REF` holds the folders Config, Input, Output, Logs, Evidence and Reports, created by the run, with `Config\Config.csv` written with the defaults and `Input\work-items.csv` with the 6 demo items.
- `Reports\run-<run id>.csv` and `.html`: 2 SUCCESS, 3 BUSINESS_EXCEPTION, 1 SYSTEM_EXCEPTION after 3 attempts (`INV:005`, a file name Windows refuses), as `expected/run-report.csv`.
- `Evidence`: 3 screenshots of `INV:005`, one per attempt. `Output`: 2 receipts. `Logs`: one line per event, the last one says the run ended COMPLETED.
- The outputs of the flow, in the Variables pane: `out_glob_bool_Success` True, `out_glob_txt_ErrorMessage` empty, `out_glob_txt_RunSummary` the JSON summary of the run.
- Optional, tab `Tests`: right-click its first action, **Run from here**. After about 2 min 30 s, `C:\Temp\tests-PAD_REF-<date>-<time>.txt` ends with `TOTAL : 24 PASS, 0 FAIL`, as `expected/tests-report.txt`. The cases work under `C:\Temp\PAD_REF_Tests`: nothing of a real project is touched.

### 1.5 Save and publish the template

**Save draft**, then **Publish** (the bar above the canvas, or the menu **File**). From then on `PAD_REF` is listed under **New › Flow from template › My templates**: [2. A process from the template](#2-a-process-from-the-template).

## 2. A process from the template

### 2.1 Create the process

In the console, **New › Flow from template**. In the dialog *Create a flow from template*: the name of your process, **Select template** › **My templates** › `PAD_REF` › **Select**, then **Create**.

The designer opens on `Main` only: every other subflow is in the **Subflows** list above the canvas; double-click one to open its tab. The variables, their External names and the notes of the actions come with it. The new flow does not change when the template changes later.

### 2.2 Change what the code marks TEMPLATE

4 subflows say, in a comment at their top, what a process replaces:

| Subflow | What to change |
|---|---|
| `Main` | keep Main as it is ; adapt Process_Item (business steps), Get_Work_Items (source) and the defaults of Load_Config (settings). A new input of Process_Item is also given by its CALL, in region 2.3.1. |
| `Load_Config` | add the default of every business setting in region 2, so the key exists even when Config.csv does not list it. |
| `Get_Work_Items` | replace region 3 by the real source (Excel, SQL, API, export of a business application), give region 1 the columns of that source and remove the demo part of region 2 ; keep one row per item. |
| `Process_Item` | replace regions 2.1 (business rules) and 2.2 (application steps) by the real process, and the key column read in region 1 ; keep the rest of regions 1, 2 and 3. |

<img src="assets/canvas-process-item.png" alt="Process_Item: marker 1 on region 2.1 (business rules), marker 2 on region 2.2 (application steps)" width="640"><br><sub>Process_Item: marker 1 on region 2.1 (business rules), marker 2 on region 2.2 (application steps)</sub>

<img src="assets/canvas-get-work-items.png" alt="Get_Work_Items: markers on regions 1 (columns), 2 (demo part) and 3 (the source)" width="640"><br><sub>Get_Work_Items: markers on regions 1 (columns), 2 (demo part) and 3 (the source)</sub>

<img src="assets/canvas-load-config.png" alt="Load_Config: the marker shows region 2, the defaults of the settings" width="640"><br><sub>Load_Config: the marker shows region 2, the defaults of the settings</sub>

A complete example: [Example: invoice reminders made from the template](README.md#example-invoice-reminders-made-from-the-template).

### 2.3 Test, then run

Tab `Tests`: right-click its first action, **Run from here**. Add one case for each rule you wrote; every line must say PASS. Then tab `Main`, **Run**, and read the log and the run report.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Run from here is greyed out in Tests | Right-click the first action of the subflow, at the very top of the canvas: the menu item is greyed out on an action inside a region. |
| Errors pane: Missing argument(s) on a Run subflow action, after an input was added to a function | Every CALL gives every input of the function: add the new input to the CALL in `Main` (region 2.3.1 for `Process_Item`) and in `Tests`. |
| In a flow made from the template, only the tab Main is open | The other subflows are there: open the **Subflows** list above the canvas and double-click one to open its tab. |
| The run is FATAL with 'Input file not found' | Put the file named by `InputFile` in the folder Input, or set `CreateDemoInput` to True in `Config.csv` for the demo. |

Other cases: [Troubleshooting a paste](../../docs/troubleshooting.md) · [report a problem](https://github.com/anne-automates/pad-samples/issues/new?template=sample-does-not-work.yml&title=%5Bprocess-framework-template%5D+).
